description: Search the maap catalogue of trained targets. A target is one specific number the model can predict, named by id. Call this FIRST to find the id to pass to `estimate`; ids cannot be guessed. Filter by keyword and by kind of number.

primitive.description: amount = money-like, count = whole numbers, measure = a reading on a scale.

query.description: Keyword matched against the id and the description, e.g. "price", "pollution", "rings".

name: list_targets
